title: The Additive Arithmetic of Linear Orders
summary: We present a systematic development of the arithmetic of the class of linear orders under the ordered sum $(LO, +)$ and prove a number of new results. Our approach is based on a Euclidean algorithm for pairs of linear orders that almost additively commute. Among our results: (i.) We generalize and give unified proofs of the main classical theorems for $(LO, +)$, including Lindenbaum's division theorem for $(LO, +)$ and a representation theorem for additively commuting pairs of linear orders due to Aronszajn.
